# testdata/adsb

Manned-traffic recordings that `sim-ansp-feed` and `sim-adsb` replay
(`manned.Recording`): one JSON object per line, `t_s` seconds from the
start, `icao24`, `callsign`, `lat`, `lon`, and the receiver's units as
dump1090's README-json.md names them: `alt_baro_ft`, `alt_geom_ft`,
`gs_kt`, `track_deg`, `baro_rate_fpm`, `squawk`.

`synthetic-approach.jsonl` is **synthetic**: two aircraft generated by a
straight-line formula (one descending at 700 ft/min on a 134 degree
track at 140 kt, one level northbound at 90 kt), near Tbilisi. It is not
a recording of real traffic and proves only the replay path.

A public ADS-B recording with its source and licence (the brief asks for
one) is not committed: fetching it is a download the owner approves, and
its licence must allow redistribution. Until then scenarios fly manned
traffic as straight legs placed by offsets from the lab origin
(`feeds[].tracks`), which needs no file.
